svg.title: How the text of an issue and its comments reaches the AI
svg.desc: Each text of the issue and its comments loses its HTML, as GitHub hides it, then its link reference definitions and footnotes without a reference, which GitHub shows as nothing as well, each with a note in its place, then the characters that GitHub shows as nothing, and is cut off after 20,000 characters. In this order, no invisible character can end an HTML comment that GitHub never ends. It goes into a code fence with one backtick more than its longest run of backticks, so that no line of the text can end it. The heading above the fence, which only the script writes, names the author, the role and the date. The other issues and discussions become excerpts without HTML and definitions, lose their invisible characters too and go into JSON. The titles of the issues that a maintainer corrected lose their invisible characters as well and reach corrections.md as JSON strings in a code fence that no title can close. A notice in the log counts the definitions and the characters that were removed.
